text.en: Most pet owners praise Dr. Alexander Martinez and his front desk team for their patience, warmth, and thorough veterinary care. Longtime clients highlight that the staff remains calm and supportive during stressful visits and emergencies. However, one client felt that veterinary medical decisions were negligent, but the overwhelming majority describe a team that listens closely to pet owners.

title.en: Gentle handling for dogs and cats

text.en: Clients frequently note how gently their pets are treated throughout examinations, routine vaccinations, and post-surgery care. Reviewers with anxious or sick animals appreciate that the doctors and veterinary assistants take time to soothe pets and reduce stress. Owners express deep trust in the clinic when leaving their dogs and cats for procedures.

Pet parents report positive medical outcomes for emergency surgeries, dental cleanings under anesthesia, and wound treatments. Several clients mention that timely diagnoses helped their pets recover quickly from sudden illnesses or accidents. While one reviewer reported a serious medical complication following medication, most owners express confidence in the clinical treatments.

q.en: Does Aardvark Animal Clinic handle emergency pet visits?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the veterinary team accommodated urgent surgical cases and emergency treatments during clinic hours.
Appointments are standard, though one client noted waiting over an hour despite scheduling in advance.

q.en: Can pets undergo dental cleanings at the clinic?

a.en: Yes, clients mention successful dental cleanings performed under anesthesia.

q.en: How do clients rate the pricing at Aardvark Animal Clinic?

a.en: Reviewers describe the fees as fair and reasonable compared to other area veterinary practices.
